description: Static noise margin (SNM) of a 6T SRAM cell by the butterfly method: two cross-coupled transfer curves and the side of the largest inscribed square. Returns the margin per mode (hold/read/write), the per-lobe split (which side would flip) and, optionally, the margin expressed in sigmas and the array failure probability. NOT the diagonal shortcut, which returns twice the correct value. First-order Shichman-Hodges: no body effect, no process variation, no parasitics — it shows why the margin moves, it is not a silicon signature.

cellRatio.description: Pull-down / access width ratio. Rules read stability

cells.description: Array size, with sigmaMv, for the probability that at least one cell fails

mode.description: read opens the word line with both bit lines precharged (read disturb); in write, 0 is the correct result

pullUpRatio.description: Pull-up / access width ratio. Too high and the cell refuses to be written

sigmaMv.description: Cell-to-cell spread of the margin (mV), to express the SNM in sigmas

vth.description: Threshold voltage, same for nMOS and pMOS (V)

name: sram_noise_margin
